PullRequest.Title: Disable screenshots for flaky Session Activity Bar submenu fixture
PullRequest.Body:
The Session Activity Bar `SubmenuOpen` fixture produces flaky screenshot comparisons. Mark it as `animated` across all themes so it stays available in Component Explorer but is excluded from automated screenshot capture.

The same `sessions/sessionActivityBar/sessionActivityBar/SubmenuOpen/Light` image pair appears in these screenshot reports:

- [#342109 — Honor side placement for agent-session links in editor windows](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/342109#issuecomment-6220187142)
- [#342081 — Support opening links directly from Quick Open](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/342081#issuecomment-6218200704)
- [#342099 — Fix session diff statistics for inactive folder sessions](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/342099#issuecomment-6219388689), with the before/after images reversed.
- [#342079 — Update distro for Copilot BYOK voice speech proposal](https://github.com/microsoft/vscode/pull/342079#issuecomment-6218076005)

### Flaky screenshot variants

These are the two outputs reported for `sessions/sessionActivityBar/sessionActivityBar/SubmenuOpen/Light`. The reports above alternate between them; #342099 shows the reverse transition.

| Variant A | Variant B |
| --- | --- |
| ![SubmenuOpen Light variant A](https://hediet-screenshots.azurewebsites.net/images/93e70fb1bc5b65b1937f13a511e8d31ad92672193d9633c6100cbfcb8ed8fb25) | ![SubmenuOpen Light variant B](https://hediet-screenshots.azurewebsites.net/images/318af8e0f60bbaeeb33e943fc14ffa401c3f0347d3b80fd67e17cabf6e27c2e2) |

Validation: editor diagnostics and `git diff --check` passed. No runtime tests were run for this metadata-only change.

Fixes #342130

Scenarios.Scenario: Automated Component Explorer screenshot capture in the component-fixtures CI job
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The CI command enumerates fixtures labeled `.screenshot` and matching `/Light$/`, renders each selected fixture in Chromium, captures a PNG, and writes the manifest. The changed label removes `sessions/sessionActivityBar/sessionActivityBar/SubmenuOpen/Light` from that critical path; no new work is added.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Run the Component Explorer renderer and its Chromium session for selected screenshot fixtures.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One existing renderer process per CI job; the diff does not add a process and removes one selected fixture render within it.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same process rendered the SubmenuOpen Light fixture because its label resolved to `.screenshot`.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The process remains on the CI screenshot critical path, but this fixture no longer contributes render latency.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Capture the fixture PNG and update the current screenshot manifest/artifacts.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Previously one PNG/manifest entry for the matching SubmenuOpen Light variant per run; after the diff, zero for this fixture.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Automated capture encoded and persisted this fixture's Light screenshot.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The diff removes this fixture's image encoding and write from the job's serialized capture path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Upload the aggregate screenshot artifact/service archive after capture.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One aggregate upload per CI run; its payload has one fewer fixture image after this diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The aggregate upload included the SubmenuOpen Light screenshot.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Upload remains downstream of capture but receives less data; no additional request is introduced.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One effective fixture variant per CI run: the command's `/Light$/` filter excludes Dark and both High Contrast variants, while the new `animated` label excludes the remaining Light variant.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The project configuration sets `worktree.maxSlots` to 1, so selected fixture capture is serialized; the diff removes one serialized unit and introduces no burst or queue.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Fixture metadata is evaluated during explorer loading. Browser/module caches may make later fixture renders warmer, but the label filter prevents this fixture from rendering in either cold or warm automated capture. No cache key, invalidation, coalescing, or negative-cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: resolveLabels maps `screenshot` to `.screenshot` and `animated` to `animated`, the CI capture command selects Light screenshots, and only the `openSubmenu` fixture takes the changed branch.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The exact milliseconds and PNG bytes saved are not measured, but magnitude uncertainty cannot turn removal of work into a regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The diff removes one flaky fixture render, PNG capture, and artifact payload from CI.

Scenarios.Scenario: Manual exploration of the Session Activity Bar SubmenuOpen fixture
Scenarios.CriticalPath: A developer selects the still-registered animated fixture, which then runs the unchanged activity-bar/chat render, waits for layout stability, hovers the submenu, and waits for it to open. The changed label is registration metadata and does not add work to this on-demand render path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Load the existing dynamically imported chat-widget fixture module/assets from the local Component Explorer server on a cold manual render.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one cold module fetch per browser cache lifecycle, then reused; unchanged by the diff.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Manual selection performed the same dynamic import and render.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The module must be available before the manually selected fixture can finish rendering, exactly as before.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One selected fixture at a time, with four available theme variants; work does not scale with application data or history, and each manual selection has the same render cardinality as before.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Explorer UI may render fixtures independently, but this fixture is invoked only on selection; the diff adds no scheduler, parallel fan-out, or backpressure change.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: A cold selection may load the existing chat-widget module and a warm selection may reuse it. The label change neither changes module/cache keys nor forces reconstruction beyond the same user-requested render.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the fixture remains registered through defineFixtureVariants, and its render callback and open-submenu logic are unchanged.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Actual local render duration depends on browser and cache warmth, but the changed metadata does not alter that duration mechanism.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. Manual availability and render cost are preserved.

Scenarios.Scenario: Component fixture registration and explorer listing
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Loading the fixture module constructs 16 fixture definitions and resolves each label before the explorer can list them. The diff adds one boolean conditional per definition, entirely in process and off product runtime paths.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Fixed at 16 activityBarFixture calls in this module, with only one true `openSubmenu` option; it does not grow with user data, sessions, or application lifetime.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous module evaluation with no queue or asynchronous fan-out introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Module evaluation follows the explorer's normal module cache; the label expression does not add or invalidate a cache.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the only added operation is a fixed-size conditional selecting one of two string labels.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material; the fixed metadata branch is negligible and cannot establish an actionable performance regression.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The fixed registration-time branch has no realistic user-visible performance impact.

Analysis.Summary: Reviewed the complete one-file diff and traced automated capture, manual rendering, and fixture registration. The change reclassifies only SubmenuOpen variants from screenshot to animated, eliminating one serialized Light screenshot from CI while leaving on-demand rendering unchanged. No performance finding or regression-fix learning record is warranted.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
